title: Next seek state
statement: For a natural number $k$, ranks $r,s$ with $0 \le r,s < 3^{k+1}$, and a Boolean $b$, define the next seek state as follows: if $s=0$, it is done when $b$ is true and is the state with rank $r$ when $b$ is false; if $s>0$, it is the request state with ranks $r$ and $s-1$ and flag $b$.
